locator: CCC 12, Hic Catechismus ad eos praecipue dirigitur qui catechesis officii sponsores habentur
interpretation: CCC 12: 'Hic Catechismus ad eos praecipue dirigitur qui catechesis officii sponsores habentur: imprimis ad Episcopos ... Per Episcopos ad illos ulterius dirigitur qui catechismos redigunt, ad presbyteros et ad catechistas. Eius autem lectio omnibus aliis christifidelibus utilis etiam erit.' It describes addressees, not what the faithful in fact say.
attribution: The passage states that the Catechism is addressed chiefly to bishops and, through them, to those who compose catechisms, to priests and to catechists, and that its reading will also be useful to all other faithful, which is the premise.
